title: Wholesome Algerian White Bread
description: A delicious and crispy homemade white bread with an Algerian twist, made with wholesome ingredients.
instructions: 1. In a large mixing bowl, combine warm water, yeast, and a pinch of sugar. Let it sit for 5-7 minutes until frothy.
2. Add in flour, spice mix, salt, and olive oil. Mix until a shaggy dough forms.
3. Knead the dough for 10-12 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
4. Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 1-2 hours until doubled in size.
6. Punch down the dough and shape it into a round or oblong loaf.
7. Place the loaf on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, and bake for 25-30 minutes until golden brown.
8. Remove the bread from the oven and let it cool on a wire rack for 10-15 minutes before slicing.
